attempt.reason: Batched functional requests from moss, ivo.

args.name: Obtain and assess a food-cutting stone edge
args.function: Provide a feasible personally learnable method to obtain or shape a carried stone or flint edge suitable for the thin-slice-food-drying-trial, with an actual assessment of whether the resulting edge meets its contact requirements.
args.conditions: I have roots but no owned cutting tool. A weathered stone source is visible at (11,20.5), stock 7; its suitability is unknown. The trial requires edge radius at most 0.0002, hardness at least 8, and no fracture or contamination. Do not assume this source meets those properties.
args.inputs: Specify actual required stone or flint, tools, work location and assessment equipment; none is assumed already obtained.
args.costs: Unknown. Specify learning, travel, gathering, shaping and assessment costs and any injury risk. Prefer a small, low-risk trial.
args.effects: Enable obtaining and assessing a real cutting edge if feasible, or identify the unmet requirements. Registration alone must not create equipment, certify an untested edge, or establish food safety.

args.name: Hazelnut opening trial
args.function: Open a small owned hazelnut sample mechanically and inspect the actual shell and contents, retaining usable contents separately if feasible.
args.conditions: Nearby hazelnuts are visible and a small sample is being collected. Observation has established plant stock and maturity, not food safety or nutritional properties. No tool or processing skill is assumed.
args.inputs: An owned hazelnut sample; any additional tool or support must be specified and actually acquired if necessary.
args.costs: Method, time, effort, material loss and required equipment are unknown; provide a minimal feasible contract.
args.effects: Perform an actual opening trial and record observed yield, losses and visible condition. Do not infer toxicity, nutrition, preservation or safe consumption from appearance alone. No eating is requested.

records.access: Stable600-code-unit pages, zero-based part; concatenate all parts before parsing. Use the same exact id for continuation.

preservationPhysics.initialization: Version-1 berry/root water fraction is a physical-model assumption, not measured evidence.
preservationPhysics.condition: Exact water and nutrient/toxin totals are physical audit state; paid evidence is recorded separately.

candidates.function: Cut one whole unit of your own root or berry into thin slices with a carried stone or flint edge, lay them in one thin layer on open ground or a food surface to air-dry under actual weather, optionally keeping a carried same-stack control; inspect; re-lay slices you picked up; stop.
candidates.costs: Study: 4 rounds, 0.5 energy each. prepare: inputStackId, your own unspoiled uncut root or berry stack with 1 + controlQuantity whole units (one unit per trial); toolId, your own carried whole stone or flint unit whose edge passes the world contact model (radius at most 0.0002, hardness 8+, not fractured or contaminated); a layer area of 5 x unit mass: a ground footprint centred at x,y (default your position) within 0.65 plus your radius, or supportId, a food surface in reach at least that large. One round, 1.5 energy. inspect: in reach of the slices or carrying them; one round, 0.2 energy. resume: re-lays slices you picked up, same placement rules, no cutting; one round, 0.2 energy. stop: one round, no energy. All checks run before any charge; travel, gathering and pickup are separate. instrumentId is refused: no calibrated balance exists.
candidates.effects: Cutting keeps the unit's mass, water, nutrition, toxicity, decay and age; no offcut is represented; the edge gains no wear. Slices lie unowned as one sample with the world food water record (assumed water fraction root 0.75, berry 0.85; opening damage 1.1). Each round: water moves toward an equilibrium fraction 0.1 + 0.25 x air humidity (0.1-0.35) by at most 0.025 x area x (temperature - 5)/20 (0-2), so no gradient or warmth, no drying; rain on the uncovered layer adds 0.01 x rain x area; decay is the ordinary rate x 1.1 x (0.15 + 0.85 x water fraction/initial) (0.15-1.5), never reset. The control ages normally while carried. Inspect records elapsed rounds, quantities, model decay of slices and control and their difference, visible shrinkage and wetness, and rain rounds as an unverified record; shrinkage does not measure water; spoilage, contamination, preservation and safety stay unverified. Anyone may take lying food: you taking the slices pauses the trial until resume; others taking them, spoilage, stop or death end it and release the control once. No refund or reward.

candidates.function: Lay whole units of your own food on open ground or an existing food surface to expose them to actual weather, optionally keeping a carried control from the same stack; inspect both decay trajectories; stop the trial.
candidates.costs: Study: 2 rounds. Start: inputStackId is the exact id of your own unspoiled, untreated berry or root stack (or food whose water composition is already represented); quantity whole units to expose; optional controlQuantity whole units of the same stack kept carried and reserved (together at most its whole units). Place at x,y (default your position) within 0.65 plus your body radius, or on supportId, an existing food surface in reach. One round and 1 + 0.5 x quantity energy; all checks run before any charge; walking there is a separate navigate. Inspect: your open trial, within reach of the batch; one round, 0.2 energy. Stop: one round, no energy. Taking the food back uses pickup at its own cost. No tool, fuel, cutting or material is used or made.
candidates.effects: Start separates the units and lays them, unowned, on a ground footprint of 0.04 per unit (firm ordinary ground inside the world, not water, wet bank or waterlogged ground, unobstructed, nothing else lying there) or on the support, and gives them the world food water record (assumed water fraction root 0.75, berry 0.85). Every later round the existing rules apply: whole food loses no water; rain on the uncovered surface adds 0.01 x rain x area water; decay continues at the ordinary rate for the temperature where the food lies and is never reset. The control ages normally while carried. So no dryness, preservation or safety status can be reached: they stay unverified; nutrition and toxicity are unchanged; contamination is not assessed. Anyone may pick up food lying in the world: taking part reduces the batch, taking all ends the trial. Inspect records elapsed rounds, quantities, decay at placement and now and per round for batch and control, their difference and rain on the batch, as an unverified personal record; water content is not measured. Spoilage under the existing rule or removal ends the trial; stop ends it and leaves the batch where it lies. Ending releases the control once; death ends it the same way. No refund, reward or comfort.

candidates.effects: World review reuses equivalents or returns a structured development request. No request, learning or descriptive reward. Unknown methods and costs are allowed; the reviewer supplies a minimal feasible specification.

candidates.function: Travel toward a self-chosen coordinate or known object/item using observed obstacles.
